editorial:
Imagine waking up as a millionaire overnight. That is exactly what happens to Ateng and Iskak, two simple farm workers who hit the lottery jackpot. They immediately ditch their quiet village life and head to the big city of Jakarta to spend their riches. The vibe is lighthearted and silly, focusing on the funny culture shock as these two country boys try to fit into the flashy world of the city. You will love their chemistry and the way they bumble through high-society situations without any clue how things actually work.

The acting is naturally funny, and the pacing keeps things moving quickly so you never get bored. While some of the jokes feel a bit dated since it is from 1975, the charm of the lead duo makes up for it. If you enjoy old-school comedies about fish out of water, you should definitely give this one a try. Since it is a classic, you might want to look for a restored version to stream in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or maybe add the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: After all their fancy city adventures, Ateng and Iskak realize that money does not buy happiness. They meet Vivi and her father, Eddy Sud, who helps them see that their roots are more important than luxury. In the end, they decide to leave Jakarta behind. They return to their village to use their wealth for the good of their community, finding peace and true friendship back at home.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic comedies and stories about simple people in big cities.
